# Counts
```{r}
set.seed(12)
# Assign cells randomly to one of 3 groups
v6.1$pseudoGroup <- paste0("Group", sample(1:3, nrow(v6.1[[]]), replace = T))
table(v6.1$pseudoGroup, v6.1$Genotype)
# Aggregate expression - make sure to always include pseudoGroup (or whatever group) in the group by.
pseudo_v6.1_counts <- AggregateExpression(v6.1, assay="RNA" ,return.seurat = F, group.by = c("Genotype", "ident", "pseudoGroup"))
pseudo_v6.1_counts <- as.matrix(pseudo_v6.1_counts$RNA)

# Remove mitochondrial and ribosomal genes
keep <- grep("^mt-|^Rpl|^Rps|^Mrpl*", rownames(pseudo_v6.1_counts), invert = T)
pseudo_v6.1_counts_mt_rb_removed <- pseudo_v6.1_counts[keep, ]

dim(pseudo_v6.1_counts) ; dim(pseudo_v6.1_counts_mt_rb_removed)
```

## Metadata
```{r}
metad <- data.frame(samples = colnames(pseudo_v6.1_counts)) %>%
  mutate(group = str_extract(colnames(pseudo_v6.1_counts), "Group\\d+") %>% as.factor(), 
         genotype = ifelse(grepl("Mut", samples), "Gli3TOE", "Ctl") %>% as.factor(),
         cluster = str_extract(colnames(pseudo_v6.1_counts), "(?<=_)[^_]+(?=_)") %>% as.factor(),
         cluster.genotype = paste0(cluster, "_", genotype) %>% as.factor()) %>%
  column_to_rownames("samples")

metad$cluster.genotype <- relevel(metad$cluster.genotype, ref="SHF_Ctl")
metad$cluster <- relevel(metad$cluster, ref="SHF")
metad$genotype <- relevel(metad$genotype, ref = "Ctl")
```

```{r}
# remove lowely expressed genes with edgeR
library(edgeR)
mm <- model.matrix(~ group + cluster.genotype, data=metad)
keep <- filterByExpr(pseudo_v6.1_counts_mt_rb_removed, design = mm)
pseudo_v6.1_counts_filtered <- pseudo_v6.1_counts_mt_rb_removed[keep, ]
dim(pseudo_v6.1_counts_mt_rb_removed)
dim(pseudo_v6.1_counts_filtered)
```
# DESeq
```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(pseudo_v6.1_counts_filtered, metad, design = ~ group + cluster.genotype)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

## PCA
```{r}
# PCA
vsd <- vst(dds)
metad$genotype <- factor(metad$genotype, levels=c("Gli3TOE", "Ctl"))
p <- pca(assay(vsd), metadata = metad, removeVar = 0.9)
# pdf("plots/PCA.pdf", width = 7, height = 4, bg="transparent")
biplot(p,
       colby = "genotype",
       shape = "group",
       lab = metad$cluster,
       legendPosition = "right")
# dev.off()
```

# Results 
```{r}
levels(dds$cluster.genotype)
contrasts <- list(
  SHF = c("SHF_Gli3TOE", "SHF_Ctl"), 
  JCF = c("JCF_Gli3TOE", "JCF_Ctl"), 
  CM  = c("CM_Gli3TOE", "CM_Ctl"),
  ECM = c("ECM_Gli3TOE", "ECM_Ctl")
)

res_deseq<- list()
for (celltype in names(contrasts)) {
  contrast = contrasts[[celltype]]
  res = results(dds, contrast = c("cluster.genotype",contrast[1], contrast[2]), alpha=0.05)
  res_deseq[[celltype]] <- res
}
# lfc shrink apeglm only works with coef and resultsNames(dds) doesn't contain all of them 
lapply(res_deseq, summary)
resultsNames(dds)
SHF <- lfcShrink(dds, res = res_deseq$SHF, coef="cluster.genotype_SHF_Gli3TOE_vs_SHF_Ctl")

dds$cluster.genotype <- relevel(dds$cluster.genotype, "JCF_Ctl")
dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds)
JCF <- lfcShrink(dds, res = res_deseq$JCF, coef="cluster.genotype_JCF_Gli3TOE_vs_JCF_Ctl")

dds$cluster.genotype <- relevel(dds$cluster.genotype, "ECM_Ctl")
dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds)
ECM <- lfcShrink(dds, res = res_deseq$ECM, coef="cluster.genotype_ECM_Gli3TOE_vs_ECM_Ctl")

dds$cluster.genotype <- relevel(dds$cluster.genotype, "CM_Ctl")
dds <- nbinomWaldTest(dds)
CM <- lfcShrink(dds, res = res_deseq$CM, coef="cluster.genotype_CM_Gli3TOE_vs_CM_Ctl")

res_deseq_shrunken <- list(SHF = SHF, JCF = JCF, ECM = ECM ,CM = CM)
rm(SHF, JCF, CM)
```

```{r}
res_deseq_shrunken <- lapply(res_deseq_shrunken, function(x) results_transform(data.frame(x), lfcThreshold = 0.5))
```

```{r}
assign_group <- function(gene, marker_list) {
  group <- "DEG"  # Default group
  for (group_name in names(marker_list)) {
    if (gene %in% marker_list[[group_name]]) {
      group <- group_name
      break
    }
  }
  return(group)
}
```

```{r}
res_deseq_shrunken <- lapply(res_deseq_shrunken, function(df) {
  df$group_shf <- sapply(df$gene_id, assign_group, marker_list=markers_shf)
  df$group_shf <- ifelse(df$differentialExpression == "not significant", "NS", df$group_shf)
  df$group_jcf <- sapply(df$gene_id, assign_group, marker_list=markers_jcf)
  df$group_jcf <- ifelse(df$differentialExpression == "not significant", "NS", df$group_jcf)
  df$label_shf <- ifelse(df$gene_id %in% unlist2(markers_shf), df$gene_id, NA)
  df$label_jcf <- ifelse(df$gene_id %in% unlist2(markers_jcf), df$gene_id, NA)
  return(df)
})

res_deseq_shrunken$SHF$group_shf <- factor(res_deseq_shrunken$SHF$group_shf, 
                                 levels = c("Cardiac", "SHF", "Hh", "BMP","Mesoderm", "DEG", "NS"))
res_deseq_shrunken$JCF$group_jcf <- factor(res_deseq_shrunken$JCF$group_jcf, 
                                 levels = c("Cardiac", "JCF", "Hh", "BMP","Mesoderm", "DEG", "NS"))
```

# GO Terms

## Cluster profiler
```{r}
universe <- res_deseq_shrunken$SHF$gene_id
GO_list <- list()
for (cluster in c("SHF", "JCF")) {
  df <- res_deseq_shrunken[[cluster]]
  name_up <- paste0(cluster, "_Up")
  name_dn <- paste0(cluster, "_Down")
  
  test_vctr_up <- subset(df, differentialExpression == "up") %>% pull(gene_id)
  test_vctr_dn <- subset(df, differentialExpression == "down") %>% pull(gene_id)
  
  GO_up <- runGO(test_vctr_up, universe, keyType = "SYMBOL")
  GO_dn <- runGO(test_vctr_dn, universe, keyType = "SYMBOL")
  
  GO_list[[name_up]] <- GO_up
  GO_list[[name_dn]] <- GO_dn
}
```

```{r}
GO_list_converted <- lapply(GO_list, function(df) {
  df <- df %>% data.frame() %>% 
    subset(qvalue < 0.05)
  return(df)
})
```

## Plot top 10
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=5.1}
# pdf("plots/GoTerms_clusterProfiler_top10.pdf", width = 6.5, height = 5.1, bg="transparent" )
for (name in names(GO_list_converted)) {
  title_split <- unlist(strsplit(name, "_"))
  title <- ifelse(title_split[2] == "Up", paste0(title_split[1], ": Gli3T OE activated"), paste0(title_split[1], ": Gli3T OE repressed"))
  df <- GO_list_converted[[name]]
  plot <- DotPlotGo(df, strWrap = 40) + ggtitle(title)
  print(plot)
}
# dev.off()
```

# GSEA clusterProfiler

```{r}
GSEA <- list()
for (res in c("SHF", "JCF")) {
  df <- res_deseq_shrunken[[res]]
  df <- df[df$baseMean > 10, ]
  df <- df[order(-df$log2FoldChange), ]
  input <- df$log2FoldChange
  names(input) <- df$gene_id
  gsea_run <- gseGO(input, keyType = "SYMBOL", OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", nPermSimple = 10000, eps = 0)
  GSEA[[res]] <- gsea_run
}
```

```{r}
write.xlsx(GSEA, "GSEAgo_cluster_profiler_BP.xlsx")
```


```{r}
pdf("plots/GSEA_cardiac_related_terms.pdf", width = 4, height = 3)
for (name in names(GSEA)){
  gsea <- GSEA[[name]]
  cardiac_terms <- grep("heart|cardiac|cardi|contration|muscle", gsea@result$Description)
  
  for (term in cardiac_terms){
    p = gseaplot2(gsea, gsea[term, "ID"], title=paste0(name, ": ",gsea[term, "Description"]), base_size = 12, subplots = 1:2)
    p[[1]] <- p[[1]] + ylab("RES")
    print(p)
  }
}
dev.off()
```


# Correlations
```{r}
shf_jcf_degs_merged <- res_deseq_shrunken$SHF %>%
  inner_join(res_deseq_shrunken$JCF, by='gene_id', suffix = c(".SHF", ".JCF"))
```

```{r}
shf_jcf_degs_merged <- transformMerged(shf_jcf_degs_merged, suffix = c(".SHF", ".JCF"))
```
## Scatter
```{r}
colors <- c("lightgrey" ,hcl.colors(3, "Dynamic")) %>% setNames(c("Not significant in either", "Significant in JCF", "Significant in both", "Significant in SHF"))
plotCorrelations(shf_jcf_degs_merged, suffix = c(".SHF", ".JCF"), show_labels = FALSE, show_deg_counts = F, point_colors = colors, point_size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_trans(x='asinh', y='asinh') +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=alpha) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", data=subset(shf_jcf_degs_merged, Significance == "Significant in both"), se=F, linewidth=.5, show.legend = F) +
  stat_correlation(data=subset(shf_jcf_degs_merged, Significance == "Significant in both"), use_label(c("r", "p", "R2")), method="pearson", label.y="top", size=4, alpha=1)

#ggsave("plots/Scatterplot_JCF_SHF_degs.pdf", width = 5.2, height = 2.9, bg="transparent")
```

## GO terms
```{r}
quads <- c("upper-right", "lower-left")
GO_terms_sig_in_both <- list()
universe <- shf_jcf_degs_merged$gene_id

for (quad in quads) {
  df <- shf_jcf_degs_merged %>% subset(Significance == "Significant in both" & Quadrant == quad)
  test_vector <- df$gene_id
  
  GO <- runGO(test_vector, universe, keyType = "SYMBOL")
  GO_terms_sig_in_both[[quad]] <- GO

}
```

